final_message:
Partial refunds are fixed. The bug was in `src/payments/partial-refund.js`: `percent` is documented as 0-100, but the code multiplied the amount by it directly, so a 50% refund on 1250 came out as 62500. The line now divides by 100:

```js
exports.partialRefund = (payment, percent) => ({ currency: payment.currency, amount: Math.round(payment.amount * percent / 100) });
```

`npm test` now passes all 20 tests, including both cases in `test/payments-partial-refund.test.js`. Nothing else in the repo calls `partialRefund`, so the change has no other effects. The only file modified is `src/payments/partial-refund.js`, which is within the payments scope in CLAUDE.md. I haven't committed anything.
